quest.title: Good Hunter Express
quest.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Eh? But... Oh, alright, I'll get someone else to do it...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. It's much too far away, and we haven't the people to spare.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, please be careful while you travel. <color=#00E1FFFF>Don't run too fast or use your wind glider. You definitely shouldn't climb either...</color>

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you takes too many bumps along the way, the meat sauce and spaghetti might come apart... and if that happens, I don't think the customer will accept it.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Slacking Angelo

dialogues.speaker: Slacking Angelo
dialogues.text: Sheesh, I wonder where my order's gone. And I'd gone through so much trouble to find a comfortable spot like this, too...

dialogues.speaker: Slacking Angelo
dialogues.text: Ah, you're finally here. If you'd taken any longer, I might have fallen asleep.

dialogues.speaker: Slacking Angelo
dialogues.text: Thank you, I'll just take this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Right, I believe a certain... Angelo ordered — and paid for — a serving of our Flaming Red Bolognese.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: After that, he asked that we deliver it to him near Brightcrown Canyon. But that's some distance away, and I don't have anyone I can send there...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you're alright with it, could you help us deliver it to him?

dialogues.speaker: Slacking Angelo
dialogues.text: Sheesh, I wonder where my order's gone. And I'd gone through so much trouble to find a comfortable spot like this, too...
